+"""SQLite persistence for users."""
+
+import sqlite3
+
+_conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:", check_same_thread=False)
+_conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
+_conn.execute("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE)")
+_conn.executemany("INSERT INTO users (id, name, email) VALUES (?, ?, ?)", [
+    (1, "Ada Lovelace", "ada@example.com"),
+    (2, "Linus Torvalds", "linus@example.com"),
+    (3, "Grace Hopper", "grace@example.com"),
+])
+_conn.commit()
+
+
+def _to_dict(row):
+    return dict(row) if row else None
+
+
+def get_by_id(user_id: int) -> dict | None:
+    return _to_dict(_conn.execute("SELECT id, name, email FROM users WHERE id = ?", (user_id,)).fetchone())
+
+
+def find_by_email(email: str) -> dict | None:
+    return _to_dict(_conn.execute("SELECT id, name, email FROM users WHERE email = ?", (email,)).fetchone())
+
+
+def get_all() -> list[dict]:
+    return [dict(row) for row in _conn.execute("SELECT id, name, email FROM users").fetchall()]

+"""User service."""
+
+from app.db import store
+
+
+def get_user(user_id: int) -> dict | None:
+    return store.get_by_id(user_id)
+
+
+def name_stats() -> dict:
+    """Return count, min, max and average length of user names."""
+    lengths = [len(user["name"]) for user in store.get_all()]
+    count = len(lengths)
+    if count == 0:
+        return {"count": 0, "min": 0, "max": 0, "average": 0.0}
+    return {
+        "count": count,
+        "min": min(lengths),
+        "max": max(lengths),
+        "average": round(sum(lengths) / count, 2),
+    }

+"""Request handlers."""
+
+from app.services import users
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
+
+
+def handle_name_stats(params: dict | None = None) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    return 200, users.name_stats()

--- a/tests/test_name_stats.py
+++ b/tests/test_name_stats.py
@@ -0,0 +1,16 @@
+from app.api.handlers import handle_name_stats
+
+
+def test_name_stats_ok():
+    # Seeded users: "Ada Lovelace" (12), "Linus Torvalds" (14), "Grace Hopper" (12).
+    status, payload = handle_name_stats({})
+    assert status == 200
+    assert payload == {"count": 3, "min": 12, "max": 14, "average": 12.67}
+
+
+def test_name_stats_ignores_params():
+    assert handle_name_stats({"id": "1", "unexpected": "value"}) == handle_name_stats(None)
+
+
+def test_name_stats_callable_without_params():
+    assert handle_name_stats()[0] == 200
